decision_rule: The holdout verdicts are the headline results; the 1990+ replication was seen during development and is reported as supporting evidence only.

hypotheses.H1: Primary's out-of-sample stress-day basket correlation < Top-k Quality (paired Wilcoxon, one-sided, alpha=0.05)
hypotheses.H2: Primary's volatility < EW-All 1/N (block-bootstrap 95% CI of ratio entirely below 1)
hypotheses.H3: Primary's volatility < pure-diversity SR-DAS theta=0 (95% CI of ratio below 1)
hypotheses.H4: Primary's Sharpe not significantly below EW-All 1/N (two-sided block bootstrap, alpha=0.05)
hypotheses.H5: RQ1: stress-day basket correlation < Stress-Cluster rule (one-sided Wilcoxon)
hypotheses.H6: RQ2: stress-day basket correlation < same method with all-day correlation (one-sided Wilcoxon)
hypotheses.H7: RQ3: stress-day basket correlation < same method with single-window estimate (one-sided Wilcoxon)

multiple_testing: Holm correction across all Sharpe comparisons of the primary method
primary_method: B-SR-DAS (balanced): log-det on robust stress correlation, theta set by balanced_theta (beta=1)
secondary_method: S-SR-DAS: top 50% by quality, then pure log-det (theta=0) on robust stress correlation
